blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.

blocks.purpose: Provide the light edge-of-breakup crunch needed for choruses without sounding like Plexi.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is chosen to simulate a clean, articulate breakup rather than heavy grit.
